fields.description: Requires the fcm_360ithub app to be installed. Skipped silently otherwise.
fields.label: Mobile push (FCM) notifications

fields.description: Webtoolex requires the webtoolex_whatsapp app. Every send is recorded in WhatsApp Message Log regardless.
fields.label: WhatsApp provider

fields.description: Leave empty to use the provider's default instance.
fields.label: WhatsApp Instance name

fields.description: Replaces v1's hard-coded production-site check. Off by default on new sites.
fields.label: Send 08:00 WhatsApp task digest

fields.default: The digest runs at 08:00 site time on working days (skips Sundays and Holiday List dates).
fields.label: Note

fields.description: Users who can approve or reject Teachers Timesheets and raise teacher invoices and payments. TNC Manager and Administrator always can.
fields.label: Timesheet approvers
Penalty imposers
fields.description: Users who can create and submit teacher penalties. Administrator always can. Leave empty to allow every TNC Manager.

fields.label: Penalty approvers
fields.description: Users who approve or reject teacher penalties, on the web and in the app. Administrator always can. The person who imposed a penalty cannot approve it, except Administrator.

fields.label: Penalty recovery account
fields.description: Income account that receives recovered teacher penalties (for example an 'Indirect Income' account named by TNC Finance). Required before a payment can deduct a penalty.

fields.label: Institute name on teacher documents
fields.description: Printed at the top of the payment receipt and weekly statement. Logo, address, phone and email come from the Company and its address.

fields.label: Send weekly report card to teachers on WhatsApp (Saturday)
fields.description: Every Saturday the week's settlement (Saturday to Friday) is generated for each teacher. Tick this to also WhatsApp the summary to the teacher's mobile.

fields.label: Send payment receipt to teacher on WhatsApp
fields.description: When a teacher is paid, a PDF receipt goes to the mobile number on the Teacher record.

fields.label: Settlement start date
fields.description: Weekly settlements count timesheets, penalties and payments from this date. Set it to the day teacher payouts start going through the system, so old timesheets paid outside it are not shown as owed.

fields.label: Attendance Hold after consecutive absences
fields.description: A student absent this many times in a row (days or classes, see below) is put on Attendance Hold for that batch. Only Counsellor, Manager or Super Admin can release it, with remarks.

fields.label: Count Absences By
fields.description: Days: a day with no punch counts as one absence. Classes: each class missed counts as one (two subjects missed on one day = 2).

fields.label: Late after (minutes)
fields.description: Default grace after the batch start time before the first punch counts as Late. A batch can override it.

fields.label: Class Days From
fields.description: Teacher timesheets: a batch has a class on a date when a teacher logged one (From/To time on the row gives the class window). Batch class days: the Mon-Sun ticks and start time on the batch.

fields.label: Class time required on timesheets
fields.description: When on, a timesheet row for a class (batch set, or a 'Class with students' activity) must carry From and To time. Keep off until every teacher has the app version with the time fields; rows without times create no class day.

fields.label: Rebuild Last N Days Nightly
fields.description: Timesheets filed late are picked up for this many days back. A timesheet also rebuilds its own date the moment it is saved.

fields.label: Minimum Stay (minutes)
fields.description: A day counts as Present only if the student stayed at least this long (needs the OUT punch). 0 = any punch is Present.

fields.label: When only one punch is recorded
fields.description: A day with an IN but no OUT (or an OUT but no IN). Present: the student is taken to be in until the end of the day. Partial: the classes count as Partial, lowering the percentage but not counting towards the hold; the office can add the missing punch after the teacher confirms. Absent: the day counts as absent.

fields.label: Offline: Class Counts as Present From (%)
fields.description: Machine punches. Share of a class's time the student must have been in (between IN and OUT) to be Present for that class. Below it: Partial, counted as absent. Online batches use the Google Meet 'Present From' instead.

fields.label: WhatsApp parent when an Attendance Hold starts
fields.description: Sends a short message to the parent's mobile on the Student record when the student goes on Attendance Hold after the consecutive absences above.

fields.label: Also WhatsApp parent on every absent day
fields.description: Off by default: the client asked for the hold message only. On: a message goes out each night for every day the student is marked Absent (needs the hold tick above as well).

fields.label: Parent number to use
fields.description: If that number is blank on the student, the other parent numbers are tried, then the student's own mobile.

fields.label: Google Meet (online attendance)
fields.description: Online attendance. Once connected, after each online class (timesheet row with From/To on a batch with a Meet link) the server reads who joined the meeting and writes IN/OUT punches.

fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: From the Google Cloud console, OAuth client 'TNC server'.

fields.label: Online: Present From (% of class time in the meeting)
fields.description: Total minutes in the meeting ÷ class minutes. At or above = Present, below but joined = Partial, never joined = Absent.

fields.label: Online class entry
fields.options:
Registered students join directly, others ask to join
Only registered students can join
fields.default: Registered students join directly, others ask to join
fields.description: Applies to meetings made with Create Meet link on the batch. Registered = enrolled in that batch with a Google Meet email on the student. 'Only registered' refuses everyone else outright, so a student on the wrong Gmail cannot even ask the teacher.

fields.label: Purchase Invoice approvers
fields.description: Bills entered by hand (supplier bills, salary, rent...) must be approved by one of these users before they can be submitted. Administrator always can. Teacher payout invoices made from approved timesheets skip this. Leave empty to switch approval off.

fields.label: Counsellors who can admit
fields.description: Only these users see the Admit button on a Student Enquiry and can admit a student end to end (student, enrolment, fee order, payment, admission form link). TNC Manager, TNC Super Admin and Administrator always can. Nobody else can admit while the list is empty.

fields.label: Deduct the paid demo fee from the course fee on admission
